units.zh: 卷八十四 翟方進傳第五十四
units.literal: Volume 84, Biography the Fifty-Fourth: Zhai Fangjin.
units.idiomatic: Volume 84, the fifty-fourth biography: Zhai Fangjin.

units.zh: 翟方進字子威，汝南上蔡人也。
units.literal: Zhai Fangjin, courtesy name Ziwei, was a man of Shangcai in Runan.
units.idiomatic: Zhai Fangjin, styled Ziwei, was a native of Shangcai in Runan commandery.

units.zh: 家世微賤，至方進父翟公，好學，為郡文學。
units.literal: His family for generations was humble and lowly; down to Fangjin's father, Lord Zhai, who loved learning—he became the commandery's erudite instructor.
units.idiomatic: The family had long been of humble rank; his father, Lord Zhai, loved books and served as the commandery's erudite instructor.

units.zh: 莽聞之，大懼，乃拜其黨親輕車將軍成武侯孫建為奮武將軍，光祿勳成都侯王邑為虎牙將軍，明義侯王駿為強弩將軍，春王城門校尉王況為震威將軍，宗伯忠孝侯劉宏為奮衝將軍，中少府建威侯王昌為中堅將軍，中郎將震羌侯竇兄為奮威將軍，凡七人，自擇除關西人為校尉軍吏，將關東甲卒，發奔命以擊義焉。
units.literal: When Mang heard it, he was greatly afraid; thereupon he appointed his faction and kin—Light Chariot general Marquis of Chengwu Sun Jian as Raising Martial general, Superintendent of the Household Marquis of Chengdu Wang Yi as Tiger Fang general, Marquis of Mingyi Wang Jun as Strong Crossbow general, Spring Gate Commandant of the Gates Wang Kuang as Shaking Awe general, Minister of the Imperial Clan Marquis of Loyal Filial Piety Liu Hong as Raising Assault general, Privy Treasurer Jianwei Marquis Wang Chang as Center Hard general, Gentleman of the Palace Marquis Who Shakes the Qiang Dou Xiong as Raising Might general—in all seven men; he himself chose and appointed men from west of the passes as colonels and army clerks, led east-of-the-pass armored soldiers, and issued emergency call-ups to strike Yi.
units.idiomatic: Mang was terrified. He commissioned seven kinsmen and allies: Sun Jian, Marquis of Chengwu, as Raising Martial general; Wang Yi, Marquis of Chengdu, as Tiger Fang general; Wang Jun, Marquis of Mingyi, as Strong Crossbow general; Wang Kuang, commandant of the Chunwang Gate, as Shaking Awe general; Liu Hong, Marquis of Loyal Filial Piety, as Raising Assault general; Wang Chang, Marquis of Jianwei, as Center Hard general; and Dou Xiong, Marquis Who Shakes the Qiang, as Raising Might general. Mang personally picked officers from west of the passes as colonels and staff, mobilized armored troops from the east, and called out every emergency levy to crush Yi.

units.zh: 復以太僕武讓為積弩將軍屯函谷關，將作大匠蒙鄉侯逯並為橫野將軍屯武關，羲和紅休侯劉歆為揚武將軍屯宛，太保後丞丞陽侯甄邯為大將軍屯霸上，常鄉侯王惲為車騎將軍屯平樂館，騎都尉王晏為建威將軍屯城北，城門校尉趙恢為城門將軍，皆勒兵自奮。
units.literal: Again he made Grand Coachman Wu Rang Piled Crossbow general to garrison Hangu Pass, Court Architect Marquis of Mengxiang Lu Bing Transverse Wild general to garrison Wu Pass, Minister of the Calendar Hongxiu Marquis Liu Xin General Who Displays Martial Prowess to garrison Wan, Grand Guardian and Rear Chancellor Marquis of Chengyang Zhen Han grand general to garrison Bashang, Marquis of Changxiang Wang Yun chariot and cavalry general to garrison Pingle Lodge, Cavalry Commandant Wang Yan Establishing Might general to garrison north of the city, Commandant of the Gates Zhao Hui Gate general—all tightened troops and roused themselves.
units.idiomatic: He also named Grand Coachman Wu Rang Piled Crossbow general at Hangu Pass; Court Architect Lu Bing, Marquis of Mengxiang, as Transverse Wild general at Wu Pass; Liu Xin, Hongxiu marquis and minister of the calendar, as general displaying martial prowess at Nanyang; Zhen Han, Marquis of Chengyang, as grand general at Bashang; Wang Yun, Marquis of Changxiang, as chariot-and-cavalry general at Pingle Lodge; Cavalry Commandant Wang Yan as Establishing Might general north of the walls; and Gate Commandant Zhao Hui as gate general. Each braced his command for battle.

units.zh: 莽日抱孺子會群臣而稱曰：「昔成王幼，周公攝政，而管、蔡挾祿父以畔，今翟義亦挾劉信而作亂。
units.literal: Mang daily embraced the infant heir, met the various ministers, and declared, saying: "Anciently when King Cheng was young, the Duke of Zhou acted as regent, yet Guan and Cai clasped Father Lu and rebelled; now Zhai Yi also clasps Liu Xin and raises rebellion.
units.idiomatic: Day after day Wang Mang held the boy emperor before the court and declared: "When King Cheng was a child, the Duke of Zhou ruled in his stead—yet Guan Shu and Cai Shu rallied Prince Lu Fu and rose in revolt. Zhai Yi has done the same, hiding behind Liu Xin.

units.zh: 莽晝夜抱孺子禱宗廟。
units.literal: Mang day and night embraced the infant and prayed in the ancestral shrines.
units.idiomatic: Mang day and night clutched the boy emperor and prayed in the shrines of his ancestors.

units.zh: 復拜衛尉王級為虎賁將軍，大鴻臚望鄉侯閻遷為折衝將軍，與甄邯、王晏西擊趙明等。
units.literal: Again he appointed Commandant of the Guards Wang Ji as Tiger Fury general, Grand Herald Marquis of Wangxiang Yan Qian as Assault general, together with Zhen Han and Wang Yan to strike Zhao Ming and others from the west.
units.idiomatic: He named Wang Ji, commandant of the guards, Tiger Fury general, and Yan Qian, Marquis of Wangxiang, as Assault general, and sent them with Zhen Han and Wang Yan west against Zhao Ming.

units.zh: 正月，虎牙將軍王邑等自關東還，便引兵西。
units.literal: In the first month, Tiger Fang general Wang Yi and others returned from east of the passes and thereupon led troops west.
units.idiomatic: In the first month Wang Yi, Tiger Fang general, marched back from the east and at once turned his column west.

units.en: As a boy he visited Shan Tao, who sighed long after he left and watched him go, saying, "What kind of old woman bore such a splendid child!
units.literal: Youth visited Shan Tao—Tao sighed long—already gone—eyed sent saying: "What thing old woman—gave birth such fine child!
